git_learning_scope: Each run's top-level files, workspace top-level files and complete revisions directory, excluding explicitly inventoried cache and credential paths.
git_example_link_targets: Existing local file links from reports/evidence-example-001.md; only if present in approved export manifest.
copy_bytes: Only approved export bytes, verified immediately before and after copying into an isolated Git worktree; never overwrite frozen originals with redacted bytes.
unrelated_existing_phase1_changes: Preserve in original working directory; do not stage.
deferred_publication_metadata: Final export audit, manifest/index hashes, asset URL receipt and upload verification are new metadata after this policy; original frozen artifacts remain immutable.
